# Context-associated driver genes across clinical traits (Fig. 4a)

DiffDriver was applied across 20 tumor types to six clinical traits — Tumor
Mutational Burden (TMB), Fraction of Genome Altered (FGA), Aneuploidy Score,
Diagnosis Age, Disease-specific Survival, and Progression-free Survival. For the
pan-cancer summary, the DiffDriver likelihood-ratio p values for every
gene × tumor-type test are pooled **within each trait** and a
**Benjamini–Hochberg correction is applied across tumor types within each trait**
(`data/clinical_pertrait_pvalues.tsv`; 1,968 tests, 185 unique driver genes). A
gene is called significant if it passes BH FDR < 0.1 in at least one trait.

```{r load}
library(ggplot2)
cl <- read.table("data/clinical_pertrait_pvalues.tsv",
                 header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cl <- cl[!is.na(cl$dd.p), ]
cl$fdr <- ave(cl$dd.p, cl$trait, FUN = function(x) p.adjust(x, "BH"))
sig   <- cl[cl$fdr < 0.1, ]
n_bg  <- length(unique(cl$gene))
n_sig <- length(unique(sig$gene))
cat("Driver genes tested (background):", n_bg, "\n")
cat("Genes significant in >=1 trait (BH FDR < 0.1):", n_sig,
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", 100 * n_sig / n_bg))
```

**45 of 185 driver genes (24.3%)** show differential selection for at least one
of the six clinical traits.

Per-trait pan-cancer gene counts (BH across tumor types within each trait): TMB
29, FGA 23, Aneuploidy 19, Diagnosis Age 6; the two survival traits contribute no
genes under the pan-cancer correction.

## Fig. 4a — significant driver genes by tumor type and clinical context

For each clinical context, the number of driver genes under significant
differential selection (DiffDriver BH FDR < 0.1, computed across genes within each
tumor-type analysis) is shown per tumor type; solid bars are significant genes and
the light bars are the total genes tested (pseudo-log scale).

```{r fig4a, fig.width=8, fig.height=14}
suppressMessages(library(data.table)); library(scales)
dt <- as.data.table(cl)
# per-analysis BH FDR (across genes within each tumor x trait), as DiffDriver outputs
dt[, fdr_analysis := p.adjust(dd.p, "BH"), by = .(trait, tumor)]
cnts <- dt[, .(sig = sum(fdr_analysis < 0.1), total = .N), by = .(trait, tumor)]

contexts <- c("Aneuploidy.Score", "Diagnosis.Age", "Fraction.Genome.Altered",
              "Months.of.disease.specific.survival", "Progress.Free.Survival.Months",
              "TMB.nonsynonymous")
ctx_lab <- c("Aneuploidy Score", "Patient Age", "Fraction of Genome Altered (FGA)",
             "Disease-Specific Survival", "Progression-Free Survival",
             "Tumor Mutational Burden (TMB)")
tumors <- sort(unique(dt$tumor))
cols   <- rainbow(length(tumors))
pt     <- scales::pseudo_log_trans()
y_ticks <- c(0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 30, 60); y_lab <- c("0", "", "2", "", "10", "", "60")

op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE); on.exit(par(op))
layout(matrix(1:6, ncol = 1), heights = c(rep(1, 5), 1.6))
for (i in seq_along(contexts)) {
  cc  <- cnts[trait == contexts[i]][match(tumors, tumor)]
  sig_c <- ifelse(is.na(cc$sig), 0, cc$sig)
  tot_c <- ifelse(is.na(cc$total), 0, cc$total)
  last <- i == length(contexts)
  par(mar = if (last) c(7, 5, 2, 1) else c(1, 5, 2, 1))
  plot(NULL, xlim = c(0.5, length(tumors) + 0.5), ylim = c(0, pt$transform(60) * 1.2),
       xlab = "", ylab = "", main = paste("Context:", ctx_lab[i]),
       xaxt = "n", yaxt = "n", bty = "n", cex.main = 1.3)
  title(ylab = "No. Genes", cex.lab = 1.1)
  axis(2, at = pt$transform(y_ticks), labels = y_lab, las = 1, cex.axis = 0.9)
  abline(h = pt$transform(y_ticks[y_ticks < 60]), col = "grey85", lty = 3)
  for (j in seq_along(tumors)) {
    rect(j - 0.4, pt$transform(0), j + 0.4, pt$transform(tot_c[j]),
         col = adjustcolor(cols[j], alpha.f = 0.2), border = NA)
    if (sig_c[j] > 0) {
      rect(j - 0.4, pt$transform(0), j + 0.4, pt$transform(sig_c[j]),
           col = cols[j], border = NA)
      text(j, pt$transform(sig_c[j]) + 0.2, sig_c[j], cex = 0.75)
    }
  }
  if (last) {
    axis(1, at = seq_along(tumors), labels = tumors, las = 2, cex.axis = 0.9)
    title(xlab = "Tumor Type", cex.lab = 1.1, line = 5.5)
  } else {
    axis(1, at = seq_along(tumors), labels = FALSE)
  }
}
```

## Functional enrichment gene sets (Fig. 4c–d)

The TMB-associated set and the genomic-instability set (FGA ∪ Aneuploidy) are the
inputs to the GO enrichment analysis.

```{r genesets}
tmb_set  <- sort(unique(sig$gene[sig$trait == "TMB.nonsynonymous"]))
inst_set <- sort(unique(sig$gene[sig$trait %in%
                 c("Fraction.Genome.Altered", "Aneuploidy.Score")]))
cat("TMB-associated set (", length(tmb_set), "):\n", paste(tmb_set, collapse = " "), "\n\n")
cat("Genomic-instability set (", length(inst_set), "):\n", paste(inst_set, collapse = " "), "\n")
```
